title: Loyalty rewards
branchOnly: Points, rewards and tiers on this page belong to {branch} only. Every branch runs its own programme — nothing here is shared with your other branches.

accessDenied.title: Loyalty is not available to you here
accessDenied.reason: Your role at {branch} cannot manage the loyalty programme. Ask the owner or an admin of this branch.

program.title: Points & tiers
program.loadFailed: The current programme could not be loaded, so it is not shown here — editing it from a blank form would overwrite your real earn rate and tiers. Reload the page to try again.
program.description: How fast customers earn, how far each badge is, and what it is called. Applies to this branch only.
program.rateExample: A {amount} order earns {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
program.rateBasis: Points are counted on the subtotal, before tax, fees and tip.
program.thresholdHint: Lifetime points earned, not the current balance — spending points never costs a badge. Bronze is where everyone starts.
program.birthdayHint: Added once a year, on their birthday, to the balance at this branch of every member whose birthday is on file. 0 turns the gift off.
program.wordsBody: What each badge is called on the customer’s loyalty page, and what it promises — one benefit per line, in any language. The “unlocked at” line is written for you from the numbers above, so moving a tier can never leave the wrong figure in your text.
program.starter: Where every member starts — no minimum spend.
program.unlockedAt: {points, plural, one {Unlocked at # lifetime point.} other {Unlocked at # lifetime points.}}
program.alwaysFirstOnly: Always shown first: <line>{opening}</line> — and nothing else, while this box is empty.
program.standardWording: Using the standard wording — it stays up to date if we improve it.
program.standardWordingTranslated: It is shown here in English; customers read it in their own language.
program.saved: Saved ✓ — every member’s badge at this branch was re-checked against the new tiers

errors.notAuthorized: Only the owner or an admin of this branch can change its loyalty programme.
errors.stale: The programme was changed somewhere else (another tab, device or person) after this page opened. Nothing was saved — reload the page to see the latest version, then make your change again.
errors.badRate: Points per {unit} must be between 0.01 and 100.
errors.badTiers: Tiers must climb, and each must be between 1 and {max, number} points.
errors.labelTooLong: A tier name can be at most {max} characters.
errors.tooManyPerks: A tier can list at most {max} benefits.
errors.perkInvalid: Each benefit must be a line of text of at most {max} characters.
errors.perkLineTooLong: A benefit line can be at most {max} characters.
errors.wholeNumber: Each tier needs a whole number of points.
errors.thresholdTooHigh: A tier can be at most {max, number} points.
errors.mustClimb: Tiers must climb: Silver below Gold, Gold below Platinum.
errors.badBirthday: The birthday gift must be a whole number from 0 to {max, number} points.
errors.saveFailed: The programme could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.menuItemForeign: That menu item belongs to a different restaurant. Pick an item from your own menu.
errors.menuItemOtherBranch: That item is on another branch’s menu. Pick an item from this branch’s menu.
errors.branchImmutable: A reward stays at the branch it was created at. Create it again at the other branch instead.
errors.kindShape: That combination is not valid — a % reward needs 1–100, a fixed reward needs an amount above 0, and a free item needs an item.
